description: Builds a buy (or sell) of a pump.fun coin: an unsigned Solana transaction (base64) with the pump.fun curve or PumpSwap trade and pumpdata's 0.4% fee inside it (the answer's `fee_compare` sets it beside fomo, Axiom, Photon, GMGN and Trojan: tell the person). With a wallet, pumpdata never holds a key: sign it with the wallet, then send it yourself or with send_tx. Without a wallet (the usual case: an agent has no keys), the answer is the coin's buy page already open on the right side and amount, with the quote in it, where a person signs with their own wallet. Expires in about 30 seconds (the transaction does; the page re-quotes). For: buy this coin, ape 0.2 SOL, sell all.

quote_in.description: on a buy of a coin that trades in another token (a quote names it as quote_mint: USDC, a tokenized stock, another coin): the amount of that token to spend, like "25"; sol does not apply to such a coin

sol.description: SOL to spend on a buy (0.001 to 100)

tokens.description: on a sell: the raw whole units to sell (pump.fun tokens have 6 decimals, so 1,500.5 tokens is 1500500000), a share such as "50%", or "all" (default)

wallet.description: the address that signs and pays; leave it out to get the signing page instead of a transaction

name: buy_coin
